messages:
maria.k: paging: spike in inference 5xx rate in us-west — alerted by incident-bot at 14:02 UTC. I'm on it, starting live triage.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: /alerts/INFER-5XX-THRESHOLD — 120m sustained > 3% 5xx across service=runtime-us-west. Paging oncall: @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: saw it, jumping in. brief status: errors hitting frontend->runtime path, latency slightly up.
kevin: I can help with logs and trace links. Maria, any customer impact known?
maria.k: so far a handful of requests failing with 502/504 from the runtime pool. CS reported one customer session degraded (low severity). No widespread customer-facing outage that I can see.
ash: (reacts with :eyes:) do we have a spike in queue length or batch time?
sre-oncall: queue length up ~2x on a couple of nodes. suspect patchy GPU process restarts during autoscale. Checking node events.
julia: adding tracing links — https://traces.internal/trace/abc123 and top error log snippet pasted below.
julia: ```
[E] 2026-03-14T14:01:58Z runtime: handler panic: kvcache miss NPE
stack: ...
```
kevin: looks like a mem pressure region. I'm SSHing into node-12 to dump metrics.
ash: tentative mitigation: scale down batch size for the affected model route and restrict max concurrent requests to reduce memory churn. Can we patch that live?
maria.k: yes we can apply a routing override to a lighter model variant to reduce memory usage — can someone deploy the override and keep original routing as fallback?
sre-oncall: I'll push canary routing override now. Applying config: ``PATCH /routes/runtime/modelX?route_override=variant-small``. Rolling to 2 nodes first.
incident-bot: Change deployed: routing override -> variant-small (canary 2/10). Monitoring error rate.
kevin: after canary, 5xx rate on those nodes dropped to 0.8%. Overall still ~1.9% across region.
maria.k: good signal. Let's expand canary to 6/10 and keep tracing on. If stable, we'll do full roll.
sre-oncall: expanded to 6/10. Observability: added temporary dashboard panel for per-node 5xx heatmap.
dashbot: Created adhoc panel: "runtime_us-west_5xx_heatmap" in temp org dashboard (link: https://grafana/internal/d/adhoc/5xx-heatmap).
julia: question for post-incident: our alert fired on sustained >3% over 120m — that was slow to catch a ~15m spike. Can we tune to be more sensitive to short, high bursts?
kevin: agree. Short bursts are what affect customers the most. Proposed change: add a second alert that triggers on 5xx_rate > 5% over 10m with higher priority.
maria.k: +1. Also add a suppression rule so we don't double-page for transient spikes when autoscaling kicks in.
ash: suggested PromQL for the new alert: ```sum(rate(inference_request_errors_total{region="us-west"}[10m])) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region="us-west"}[10m])) > 0.05```
kevin: can we also add a derivative-based alert on queue length growth velocity? e.g., `increase(queue_latency_seconds_sum[5m]) / increase(queue_latency_seconds_count[5m])` threshold.
sre-oncall: noted. I'll open an alert PR with both: short-burst 10m critical and existing 120m warning. Include runbook links.
maria.k: for the retro dashboard, we should add panels for: golden signals per-region (latency p95, errorrate, throughput, saturation), node-level memory/heap churn, and a drilldown from error heatmap -> traces -> affected customer request ids.
julia: +1, and add an overlay on the timeline showing when routing overrides were applied and rollout percentages.
dashbot: creating ticket: DSH-512 "retro dashboard: runtime incident panels + drilldowns" and assigning to @dashbot and @kevin.
kevin: I'll scope panels: 1) 5xx rate per-node heatmap 2) p50/p95 latency timeseries per model route 3) queue length and batch size scatterplot 4) rollout timeline panel (annotations) 5) alert thresholds summary table.
nash: for drilldowns, prefer linking to trace service with pre-filled filters. Example button config: ``/trace?service=runtime&error=true&time_from=now-30m``
sre-oncall: reminder: ensure dashboards are templated by region and cluster so oncall can switch scopes quickly.
maria.k: customer impact note for postmortem: 26 customer sessions with errors, one support ticket escalated but no SLA breach. Add that to incident doc.
julia: i'll capture that. Also we'll add a regression test to our eval suite to catch the kvcache NPE.
kevin: action items (short):
- kevin: add short-burst alert PR and queue-velocity alert (due today)
- dashbot / kevin: create retro Grafana panels and drilldowns (DSH-512)
- julia: add trace/runbook links and capture customer impact in incident doc
- sre-oncall: follow up with infra team on node restarts logs and autoscaler behavior
- maria.k: schedule oncall+product sync to decide if model default should be variant-small for this tenant class

maria.k: thanks everyone — keeping thread open for handoff. @sre-oncall I'm handing over monitoring and follow-ups to you for the overnight shift. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: taking handoff. Will post updates in the incident doc and mark follow-ups in the ticket.
kevin: ping me if you need help with dashboard templating.
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INFER-2026-03-14-2460011122. Severity: P2. Links: /incidents/2460011122"
